headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals handed the Philadelphia Phillies one of the worst losses in franchise history with a 15-1 victory. The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, while the Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a thrilling matchup.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Max Rajcic has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals due to right elbow soreness. Martín Pérez has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Atlanta Braves with a left forearm contusion. Other notable injuries include Brandon Woodruff's right shoulder inflammation with the Milwaukee Brewers and Tomoyuki Sugano's back spasms with the Colorado Rockies.

The New York Mets made a trade acquisition, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Washington Nationals also made a trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer Historic Loss to Royals**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 15-1, handing them one of the worst losses in franchise history. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including a home run, while Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by José Caballero's impressive performance at the plate. Caballero hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs, while Cam Schlittler pitched 8 strong innings with 8 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Nationals Come from Behind to Win 11-12**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a thrilling matchup, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate. Abrams finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs, while Enyel De Los Santos impressed on the mound with 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Thrilling 7-6 Win Over Braves**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves in a close game, securing a 7-6 victory. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow soreness.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
